messages:
maria: quick async — small ops tuck-in for today

maria: what I did: patched libpq dependency in service-auth, ran the infra vuln scan (saw a medium in libpq), opened GH issue #853 with the findings and remediation steps

maria: blockers: need an IAM cleanup to remove a stale editor binding on service-account-logger before I promote the patch to prod — I don't have perms to change bindings in prod projects

maria: today: push CR for the patch (PR #1589), coordinate IAM rollback, run a kms-key dry-run in staging, and bundle evidence for compliance (SOC2 request)

jon: thanks — saw the GH issue. can you paste the scan excerpt here or link the raw output? might help triage if it's configuration vs vuln in vendor code

maria: link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service-auth/issues/853 — paste of scanner snippet below
```
CVE-2025-1234 libpq: memory leak in PQexec -> affected versions: 1.10.x
Remediation: bump to libpq 1.10.5 or apply patch in vendor layer
```

jon: hmm ok. also flagged a separate IAM binding: project-prod: role/editor -> service-account-logger@prod. that should be `roles/logging.logWriter` only. if we leave editor it'll expand blast radius. we should remove and grant least-priv

sam: I can take the IAM rollback on prod once maria posts the exact binding line. ping me and I'll run the `gcloud` change during the maintenance window. tx

maria: thanks @sam — exact command I'm proposing for rollback (dry-run first):
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:service-account-logger@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/editor --quiet
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:service-account-logger@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/logging.logWriter --quiet
```

maria: I'll run the dry-run in staging now and paste results

deploy-bot: staging-dryrun: iam-change-preview applied for PR #1589 (patchset: ps-442). no conflicts detected. logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/ps-442

eva: heads-up for compliance — SOC2 asks for change justification and pre/post screenshots/logs. maria, can you capture the dry-run output and put into the `compliance-evidence/2026-03-17` folder in the drive? i'll curate it for the auditor packet

maria: on it — uploading the staging dry-run log now. will also add the PR link and the vuln scanner report to the folder

sam: once you upload i'll run the prod change at 09:15 PT and report back in this thread. leaving a reminder here so we have an audit trail :thumbsup:

jon: LGTM on the plan. @maria drop a quick summary in the GH issue so we have remediation timeline (staging dry-run done, prod rollback scheduled 09:15 PT)

maria: done — PR #1589 opened, GH issue updated with timeline and links. thanks y'all. will follow up after prod run

deploy-bot: prod-change-schedule: job queued (window: 09:15-09:30 PT). notify: @sam, @maria

maria: ack — will close loop after prod verification
